cv_text:
Aino Karvinen
Espoo, Finland | open to relocation
aino.karvinen@examplemail.fi | +358 40 555 0192

PROFILE
QA professional working across test design, automation and delivery pipelines, with a background in software testing for web and API-based systems.

SKILL AREAS

Software Testing
- Designed and executed functional, regression and exploratory test suites for web applications and backend services.
- Built up testing practice from trainee level onward, writing test cases, reproducing defects and reporting issues with clear steps and evidence.
- Validated REST APIs by hand and through automated checks, covering status handling, payload structure and error paths.

Test Automation
- Wrote and maintained automated test suites in pytest, structuring fixtures and parameterised cases for reusable coverage.
- Developed browser and script-level checks in JavaScript against front-end behaviour.
- Familiar with Playwright for end-to-end browser automation.

CI/CD and Tooling
- Integrated automated test runs into CI/CD pipelines so that failures surfaced on every change.
- Configured and maintained Jenkins jobs for scheduled and triggered test execution.
- Used Docker to produce consistent, disposable test environments.
- Relied on Git for branching, code review and traceability of test assets; acted as a point of reference for Git workflow questions within the team.

Data and Queries
- Used SQL to verify data states before and after test runs, prepare test data and investigate defects at the database level.

EDUCATION
B.Sc. Biology

CERTIFICATIONS
Certified ScrumMaster (CSM)

LANGUAGES
Finnish — native
English — B2
Swedish — B1

EMPLOYMENT HISTORY
QA Engineer, Ruska Systems — Feb 2025 – Present
QA Analyst, Vireo Solutions — Feb 2024 – Feb 2025
QA Engineer, Tampere Tech Group — Sep 2021 – Feb 2024
QA Trainee, Nordcom Oy — Feb 2020 – Sep 2021
